reader.notes: The open-mode guards on FileConnector are shared by every organization and refuse every non-exempt statement on a closed connector with the 85 logic-error statuses; SORT/MERGE run their own implicit opens. Probed for sequential, relative and indexed files.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR3 (cite.py OK) with §1985:VII.1.3.5 4b/4f/4g/4h. Probed the closed states the reader did not try: after CLOSE WITH LOCK, a LINAGE file never opened, and statements with an implicit file reference. r3_closed.cob printed LOCK=00, READ-AFTER-LOCK=47 INTO=KEEP (no AT END branch and the INTO target was untouched), WRITE-AFTER-LOCK=48, REWRITE-AFTER-LOCK=49, CLOSE-AFTER-LOCK=42 and CLOSE-LOCK-AFTER-LOCK=42. On the LINAGE file, LP-WRITE-CLOSED=48 for WRITE AFTER ADVANCING PAGE and LP-WRITE-EOP-CLOSED=48 for WRITE AT END-OF-PAGE, with no EOP branch taken. After the OPEN, LINAGE-COUNTER was 01, so the refused WRITEs had not touched the line counter. LP-CLOSE-TWICE=42.
